milestones.objective: Assess every identified connector and save its exact query scope, current examples or concrete blocking reason.

counting_rules: A URL or directory is a lead, not a source. Deduplicate origins, language variants, mirrors and shared connectors.
Only latest successful observations of distinct current query requests count toward ten; failures/retries/empty results do not.
Record overlap, geography and India/USA gaps; never inflate counts to meet a target.
Working query coverage is separate from production approval, full reader/rights/reliability review and broad discovery targets.
Blocked/failed outcomes count as assessed, not working; Still checking is the remaining assessment queue.

constraints: The five-connector production release was separately authorized, deployed and verified in PR #180. Recurring recovery work remains research only: no automatic runtime imports, activation or deployment.
No new database service, SQL, Redis, paid API or account setup.
No CAPTCHA/WAF bypass or bulk full-work copying; retain small metadata evidence.
Free reader login is acceptable when the catalog is queryable; label account requirements and do not create accounts automatically.
completion_definition: Every identified connector receives an evidence-backed query outcome: Working within its declared tested search scope, or Blocked/failed with a concrete cause and a considered retry/alternative decision. Finish the Still checking queue and pursue viable permitted recovery paths. Report working coverage separately from completed assessments; a blocked connector is not working. Additional full-dossier, topic and country research checks are preserved but do not gate the working-query count. Keep the hourly task enabled and reporting; do not stop because an individual provider is blocked.
analysis_capture_scope: all repository free-content research documents and JSON evidence
approved free-content design artifacts and referenced binary evidence
source-level historical/contextual findings with document and line provenance
current and failed query observations; access/policy evidence; explicit unknowns

coverage_target.denominator: All currently identified connector records; read current connector-status.json rather than freezing prompt counts.
coverage_target.working_definition: Supported real queries return relevant native items, with saved current examples and a precise supported search scope.
coverage_target.registry_verification_standard: Ten distinct passing current examples; retain actual query/relevance limits and failed/empty cases.
coverage_target.grouping: Six primary connector groups; each record counted once in the total.
coverage_target.blocked_handling: Diagnose temporary failures, implementation errors, obsolete routes, authentication and provider restrictions. Retry with backoff or a documented permitted alternative only for a useful reason; record cause/attempt/result/next trigger. Never bypass access controls.
coverage_target.additional_research_checks: Separate follow-up, not a prerequisite for query coverage reporting.
coverage_target.historical_target: Preserved in analysis/goal-reviews.jsonl; the earlier49-area/18-cell/full-dossier target is not the current hourly connector-completion gate.

reporting.owner_request: Report coverage by group and connector. A connector is complete for coverage when it can be queried to find its offered items; record failures plainly. Explain current totals, remaining work and active work.
reporting.headline_metric: Connectors with current passing query evidence / known connector records

labels.working: Supported searches return relevant native items with saved current examples and explicit scope. Normally ten examples; a reviewed exhaustive one-work subset uses two passing searches plus complete listing and empty control without padding.
labels.blocked_or_failed: Investigation deferred with a concrete access/policy/API/rights limitation; not a permanent outage claim.
labels.still_checking: Known candidate without completed current query verification and not deferred.

reporting.deeper_dossier_and_geography_audits: Retained as separate research-quality follow-up; do not describe them as the number of working search connectors.
reporting.production_note: Research queryability only; no production activation or deployment in this continuation.
reporting.blocker_reporting: Give plain causes, changed/new blocked connectors, attempts and next decisions; group recurring reasons and link the full connector list.
